system.description:
You strike with your weapon leaving a lasting mark upon them so that they may remember your zeal. Make two melee taijutsu attack, on a hit you deal your [Weapons damage] + 1d8.

Chain 1: Affected creatures must make a Constitution saving throw being Branded by your strike until the end of your next turn. While branded, the target creature is Bruised.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If cast at C-Rank or higher the weapon used gains 1 rank of Reach for this jutsu’s casting. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the damage by +1d8 and the branded creature is branded for 1 minute or until they spend a full-turn action to remove the branding. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the damage by +1d8
